[[Dehjah]] is a friend of the [[Master of Whispers]]. She originally aids you as the leader of a group of [[Djinn]] in defeating [[the Drought]]'s minions, and later on disguises herself as a [[human]] when aiding you in getting to the Drought itself.

==Dialogue==
:''"I am an engineer at the [[Mahnkelon Waterworks]]. I try my best to keep the [[Kourna|Kournan]] government from polluting the [[Elon]] any more than they have to."''

Dejarin Estate:
:''"The river flows, and I with it. I am one with the river. I am its protector."''

The Floodplain of Mahnkelon:
:''"Can you feel it? The corrupted presence of [[the Drought]] emanates strongly from deep within the walls of this compound."''

Rilohn Refuge outpost:
:''"Are you surprised to see me like this? I have disguised myself in your form to keep the Kournans from polluting the Elon anymore than they already do."''
:{{ask|gold}} '''We are ready to kill this demon.''' (After completing [[To Kill a Demon]] or [[No Me, No Kormir]].)
::''"I will take you and [[Master of Whispers|the Master]] to the Waterworks so that you may attempt to defeat the Drought. Let me know when you are ready and we will meet outside."''
::{{yes}} '''We are ready.''' (Sent to the mission if Master of Whispers is in the [[party]].)
:::''"There is no way you can defeat the Drought without the Master of Whispers. Recruit him and return to me."'' (If Master of Whispers is not in the party.)
::{{no|ingame}} '''We are not ready yet.'''

:{{no}} '''I'll be on my way.'''

Rilohn Refuge mission:
:''"The Drought is a powerful enemy. We must do everything we can to weaken it before we attempt to attack it."''

==Quotes==
:''"Cut that out! Can't you see that I'm trying to work?"''
:''"I'm an engineer, not a bloodthirsty mercenary. A little help would be nice!"''
